import re
# Login tokens
pw = {x['account_name']: x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
fs_token = apis.file_system.login(username='jepowell@gmail.com', password=pw['file_system'])['access_token']
# Show April 2023 cable receipt
receipt_path = '/home/jennifer/bills/cable/2023-04.txt'
content_resp = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=receipt_path)
print('receipt meta', {k:content_resp[k] for k in ['file_id','path','created_at','updated_at'] if k in content_resp})
text = content_resp['content']
print('content head:\n', text[:500])
# Extract amount-like number
# common patterns: $123.45, Amount: 123.45, Total 123.45
patterns = [r'\$\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{2})?)', r'(?i)total\s*[:]?\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{2})?)', r'(?i)amount\s*[:]?\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{2})?)', r'(?i)balance\s*[:]?\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{2})?)']
found=[]
for pat in patterns:
    for m in re.finditer(pat, text):
        found.append((pat,m.group(1)))
print('found candidates', found[:20], 'count', len(found))
# pick largest candidate maybe total
vals=[]
for _,v in found:
    try:
        vals.append(float(v))
    except:
        pass
print('vals', vals)
if vals:
    print('max', max(vals), 'min', min(vals))

import math

# Compute share from receipt total
total_amount = 128.0
share_per_person = total_amount / 4
print('total_amount', total_amount)
print('share_per_person', share_per_person)

# Login Venmo
pw = {x['account_name']: x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
venmo_login = apis.venmo.login(username='jepowell@gmail.com', password=pw['venmo'])
print('venmo_login', venmo_login)
access_token = venmo_login['access_token']

# Roommates from earlier
roommates = [
    {'contact_id': 571, 'email': 'connorbrow@gmail.com', 'name': 'Connor Brown'},
    {'contact_id': 572, 'email': 'mar_blac@gmail.com', 'name': 'Martin Blackburn'},
    {'contact_id': 573, 'email': 'ed_wilson@gmail.com', 'name': 'Edwin Wilson'},
]
print('roommates', [(r['name'], r['email']) for r in roommates])

# Verify each email corresponds to a Venmo user (paginate through all results)
verified = []
for r in roommates:
    email = r['email']
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    matches = []
    while True:
        page = apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=access_token, query=email, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('search_users', email, 'page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
        if not page:
            break
        for u in page:
            if u.get('email','').lower() == email.lower():
                matches.append(u)
        page_index += 1
        if page_index > 50:
            break
    print('matches for', email, len(matches))
    if matches:
        verified.append({'email': email, 'user': matches[0]})

print('verified recipients', [(v['email'], v['user'].get('first_name'), v['user'].get('last_name')) for v in verified])
print('verified count', len(verified))

# Create payment requests
amount = round(share_per_person, 2)
req_desc = 'I paid for cable bill.'
created=[]
for v in verified:
    pr = apis.venmo.create_payment_request(user_email=v['email'], amount=amount, access_token=access_token, description=req_desc)
    print('created PR for', v['email'], pr)
    created.append(pr)

print('total created', len(created))
